## Physical Security  
### Data Centers  
**Access Control:**
- Badge access only (biometric at main entrance)
- Visitor log maintained
- Escort required for non-staff
- CCTV monitoring (24/7)  
**Environmental Controls:**
- Fire suppression (sprinkler system)
- Power backup (generators, UPS)
- Climate control (temperature/humidity)
- Water detection (to prevent flooding)

raw_entities.name: Physical Security Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing physical security measures for data centers, including access control, environmental protection, and monitoring requirements to safeguard banking infrastructure and customer data.

raw_entities.name: Badge Access Control Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that data center access be restricted to badge access only, with biometric authentication required at the main entrance.
context: Badge access only (biometric at main entrance)

raw_entities.name: Visitor Log Maintenance
raw_entities.description: Requirement to maintain a visitor log for all individuals entering the data center facility.

raw_entities.name: Escort Requirement for Non-Staff
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that non-staff visitors must be escorted while present in the data center.

raw_entities.name: Continuous CCTV Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Requirement for 24/7 CCTV monitoring of data center facilities to detect and record unauthorized access or security incidents.

raw_entities.name: Fire Suppression System Installation
raw_entities.description: Requirement to maintain fire suppression systems, specifically sprinkler systems, in data center facilities.

raw_entities.name: Power Backup System Maintenance
raw_entities.description: Requirement to maintain power backup systems including generators and uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) to ensure continuous data center operations.

raw_entities.name: Climate Control System Operation
raw_entities.description: Requirement to maintain climate control systems that regulate temperature and humidity within data center facilities.

raw_entities.name: Water Detection System Installation
raw_entities.description: Requirement to install water detection systems to prevent flooding and water damage to data center infrastructure.

raw_entities.name: Badge Access Control System
raw_entities.description: Technical access control mechanism using badge-based authentication with biometric verification at the main entrance to restrict unauthorized physical access to data centers.
context: Badge access only (biometric at main entrance)

raw_entities.name: Visitor Logging System
raw_entities.description: Operational control mechanism for recording and tracking all visitor access to data center facilities.

raw_entities.name: CCTV Surveillance System
raw_entities.description: Continuous video surveillance system operating 24 hours per day, 7 days per week to monitor and record all activities within data center facilities.

raw_entities.name: Fire Suppression System
raw_entities.description: Environmental protection control using sprinkler-based fire suppression to prevent fire damage to data center infrastructure and equipment.

raw_entities.name: Power Backup System
raw_entities.description: Redundant power supply system comprising generators and uninterruptible power supplies to maintain continuous data center operations during power outages.

raw_entities.name: Climate Control System
raw_entities.description: Environmental control system that maintains optimal temperature and humidity levels within data center facilities to protect equipment and ensure operational efficiency.

raw_entities.name: Water Detection System
raw_entities.description: Environmental monitoring system designed to detect water intrusion and prevent flooding damage to data center infrastructure.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Physical Access
raw_entities.description: Risk of unauthorized individuals gaining physical access to data center facilities, potentially compromising banking infrastructure and customer data security.

raw_entities.name: Fire Damage
raw_entities.description: Risk of fire damage to data center facilities and equipment, potentially causing loss of banking services and customer data.

raw_entities.name: Power Failure
raw_entities.description: Risk of power outages causing interruption to data center operations and banking services.

raw_entities.name: Environmental Damage
raw_entities.description: Risk of environmental factors including temperature fluctuations, humidity extremes, and water intrusion causing damage to data center equipment and infrastructure.
